snippet.title: ODDCORE - Official Early Access Trailer
snippet.description:
ODDCORE Early Access is Now Available on Steam for $9.99 with a 20% discount on launch week. 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2896260/ODDCORE/

ODDCORE is a retro roguelike shooter where you stylishly blast through endless waves of corrupted entities inside a sprawling liminal nightmare. It blends weirdcore aesthetics with old-school boomer-shooter vibes, drawing inspiration from Crab Champions for its gameplay loop, Risk of Rain 2 for its progression and item systems, and ULTRAKILL for its movement and overall energy.

Our Discord community has been deeply involved in shaping the game—join us if you want to be part of the dev process!
https://discord.com/invite/4pwUckApJ7

This game is built for shooter fans who love fast, fun, turn-your-brain-off chaos with style :D

Cheers!
